_comment: Valinor Smart Cuff GUI update manifest. This feed accepts only
v3.2.* releases and is intentionally separate from version.json.
The installed client needs no GitHub credential and fails silently offline.
notes:
An unfinished inflation now has 30 seconds to produce a 10 mmHg pressure rise from its starting pressure. If it does not, Smart Cuff stops the pump, opens and latches the valve, and cancels the sequence. The check runs in both GUI and standalone inflation/refill paths; completed fills and pumpless holds are excluded.

Default and Valinor retain their own preset menus, calibration and control profiles. Protected flash/restore, open-valve low-rise faults and scored ten-minute product soaks passed with 100% Arduino telemetry delivery and zero NI gaps. Existing startup, pulse, quiet MAP+5, SysID, other-cuff and fleet qualifications remain open; experimental controllers are not included.
